gist.headline: The garden gets counted
gist.blurb: The daily app tally is in. Even gardens have spreadsheets.
gist.summary: The automated September 27 update refreshed app request and repository metrics in operations/app-management/app.json, keeping internal app records current.
gist.impact: App maintainers have an up-to-date request and repository snapshot; this does not change the user-facing API or apps.
gist.visual_concept: Depict an internal app-metrics tally rather than a new feature: Polli checks a small clipboard beside a retro monitor showing simple request and repository counters, with code-plants growing nearby.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli checks a tiny clipboard beside a retro monitor showing simple app counters, while code-plants grow in prominent lime green (#ecf874) pots against a warm cream and pastel gradient background.
